title: Tesla Coil Serpent Bloom
description: A glowing glass sphere display contains a vintage Tesla coil with crackling pink and blue electricity, a large luminous magenta flower dripping liquid, and a vibrant purple serpent with yellow eyes coiled around it. The entire surreal scene is presented as an illuminated museum exhibit against a cosmic nebula background.
